title: Spun sphere
about: A sphere turns once around its vertical axis while its latitude stripes stay in place.
program:
x = sin(v)cos(u+t)
y = cos(v)
z = sin(v)sin(u+t)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. pi
hue = u/(2pi)
size = 0.04
count = 6000

title: Rainbow torus
about: A round tube wraps around a ring as its colors follow the small circle.
program:
x = (2+0.55cos(v))cos(u)
y = 0.55sin(v)
z = (2+0.55cos(v))sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. 2pi
hue = v/(2pi)
size = 0.05
count = 7000

title: Möbius ribbon
about: A narrow band turns through one half twist before its edges meet.
program:
x = (1+vcos(u/2))cos(u)
y = vsin(u/2)
z = (1+vcos(u/2))sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = -0.32 .. 0.32
hue = u/(2pi)
size = 0.035
count = 5000

title: Figure-eight Klein bottle
about: This immersed Klein bottle crosses itself where its neck passes through the body.
program:
x = (2+cos(u/2)sin(v)-sin(u/2)sin(2v))cos(u)
y = sin(u/2)sin(v)+cos(u/2)sin(2v)
z = (2+cos(u/2)sin(v)-sin(u/2)sin(2v))sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = 0 .. 2pi
hue = v/(2pi)
size = 0.07
count = 10000

title: Pseudosphere
about: Two tractrix horns meet at a sharp rim: a surface that curves the opposite way from a sphere.
program:
x = cos(u)/cosh(v)
y = 1.2(v-tanh(v))
z = sin(u)/cosh(v)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = -2.6 .. 2.6
hue = 0.55+0.2v/2.6
size = 0.05
count = 10000

title: Enneper surface
about: A simple polynomial surface curls into three spreading lobes.

title: Catenoid
about: A catenoid pinches between two wide circular rims.
program:
x = 0.45cosh(v)cos(u)
y = 0.45v
z = 0.45cosh(v)sin(u)
u = 0 .. 2pi
v = -1.6 .. 1.6
hue = 0.55+0.1v
size = 0.035
count = 7000

title: Helicoid
about: A ruled helicoid spirals upward like a ramp with no outer rim.
program:

y = vsin(u)
z = 0.18u
u = -3pi .. 3pi
v = -1 .. 1
hue = 0.55+0.12sin(u)
size = 0.035
count = 7000

u = 0 .. 4pi
v = 0.18 .. 2.95

count = 8000
